comment: Time-bounded exceptions for the dependency-vulnerability CI gate
(tools/security_scan_gate.py). The list is normally empty: an advisory
against the pinned dependency set is resolved by upgrading the pin, not
by an entry here. An exception is valid only when it names the package,
the advisory (canonical id, plus aliases), a justification for why the
fixed version cannot be taken now, an owner role, an opened date and an
expiry date (ISO 8601; expiry at most 90 days after opened). Expired,
mismatched or malformed entries are ignored and reported - never silently
honoured. Every entry must also be listed in
